_about: Edward Augustus Freeman (1823-1892), Regius Professor of Modern History at Oxford: History of Federal Government in Greece and Italy, second edition edited by J. B. Bury (London: Macmillan), raw IA OCR, and Studies of Travel: Greece, clean Gutenberg. The federal-government title page year reads '1883' in the OCR; Bury's second edition is catalogued by IA as 1893, so the OCR likely misreads it (an inference). Also The History of Sicily from the Earliest Times, 4 vols. (Clarendon Press, 1891-1894), raw IA OCR; vol. IV was edited from his posthumous papers by Arthur J. Evans (died 1941). His English medieval histories are outside the classical brief. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted.
